Name: Implement Queue Depth Alert for Worker Fleets
Description:
Task: Implement alerting for queue depth across the entire worker fleet.

Details:
- Set a warning threshold at 1,000 jobs and a paging threshold at 5,000 jobs for all workers, including payment workers.
- Ensure system alerts when these thresholds are reached, improving incident response time.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Alerts are triggered when queue depth reaches 1,000 or 5,000 jobs.
- Confirm alert logic is functioning correctly across various worker types.
- Assign to Kofi.

Name: Fix Payment Worker Retry Logic
Description:
Task: Refactor retry logic in the payment worker to mitigate self-induced DDoS.

Details:
- Implement exponential backoff with jitter in the _process_with_retry function in payment_worker.py.
- Cap retries and send failed jobs to a dead-letter queue instead of re-enqueuing at the front.
- Create automated tests to simulate processor 503s to verify the new retry logic.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Verify retry logic applies exponential backoff and jitter.
- Ensure failed jobs are queued appropriately in a dead-letter queue.
- Assign to Marta for implementation and testing.

Name: Increase and Separate DB Connection Pools
Description:
Task: Adjust database connection pool configurations to improve API and worker performance.

Details:
- Increase the database connection pool size from 20 to 100 connections.
- Separate worker and API database pool connections to reduce coupling.
- Modify the respective configuration file to effect these changes.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Validate increased pool size effectively handles load in test scenarios.
- Ensure worker and API database connections operate independently.
- Assign the task to Kofi for integration.

Name: Update Payment Incident Runbook
Description:
Task: Revise the payment incident runbook to reflect current practices and tools.

Details:
- Replace outdated references to Kibana with current logging tools.
- Document the queue drain procedure Kofi devised on Tuesday.
- Verify and update escalation phone numbers to ensure continuity.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Confirm all runbook links are functional and up-to-date.
- Ensure queue drain procedures and contacts are accurate and accessible.
- Assign to Priya for comprehensive updates.

Name: Automate Status Page Updates
Description:
Task: Develop automation for updating the status page during an incident to reduce manual intervention.

Details:
- Integrate the status provider's API with our alerting system to automate status page updates.
- Implement an automatic message that switches the status page to 'investigating' when checkout error rate alerts fire.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Verify the automation flows correctly from alert trigger to status page update.
- Validate that the status page reflects the proper message during an incident.
- Marta to take ownership of the integration and testing.

Name: Draft and Conduct Payment Processor Failover Test
Description:
Task: Plan and oversee a controlled test of the payment processor failover system.

Details:
- Design a game day simulation to test failover mechanisms in staging and production environments.
- Develop a rollback plan to ensure system stability during the test.
- Schedule a review of the test plan to finalize details two weeks before execution.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Document a feasible and safe failover test plan.
- Review the plan with the team and incorporate feedback.
- Kofi to lead plan development and schedule the execution.

Name: Upgrade Redis to Version 7.2
Description:
Task: Perform an upgrade of Redis from version 6.0 to 7.2, addressing security and performance improvements.

Details:
- Review new configuration settings and migrate data as necessary.
- Plan and execute the upgrade during a scheduled maintenance window to minimize impact.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Ensure Redis is running on version 7.2 without error post-upgrade.
- Validate system performance and reliability with the new version.
- Task assigned to Kofi for planning and execution.
